utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That sounds right to me — late afternoon, around 3:30 to 5:00, should work best. Thanks for helping keep it lined up with pickup.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh good, that timing sounds right. If you send me the list again, I’ll help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren — I’ll send it over again. I really appreciate you helping out.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I’ve got the tools and spare parts, and I’ll double-check the route before we head out.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, thanks—I’ll still stop by after errands with a couple tools and check whether the main table needs an extra hand.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — I’ll bring what I’ve got and keep the route and supplies in order. See you there after your errands.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m checking the date, time, and drop-off spot now, then I’ll verify the tools and spare parts we already have.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great — once you’ve got the date, time, and drop-off spot, I’ll confirm the repair drive plan and share the details with everyone.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Vik — I’ll verify those details now and let you know as soon as I’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yep, I’m still good — I’ll bring the tools by this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, Noah — thanks for bringing the tools by this afternoon. I’ll get the tables and sorting set up at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good — I’ll swing by this afternoon with the tools, and if I find any extra safety gear I’ll bring that too.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm the repair drive plan once it’s set? I’m not calling it settled until I see the details.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still piecing it together, but I’ll pass along the latest as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Alright — just let me know once it’s confirmed. I’m waiting on the details before I treat it as settled.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Of course — just send me a note if the timing shifts, and I’ll work around pickup.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Faye. I’ll wait for your pickup note and keep my schedule clear for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — I’ll send the pickup note if anything changes, and otherwise we’ll keep that late-afternoon window open.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Could you help sort donations by the garage? We still need a hand with the tools and boxes.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely — I’m keeping the repair drive list updated, so I’ll send over the current needs and any changes. Thanks for sorting the tools and boxes by the garage.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, thanks — send the updated list when you can, and I’ll keep sorting by the garage.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m starting at the community center, then I’ll check the bulletin board by the café and note what’s still open.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect—thanks, Opal. I’ll keep an eye out and be ready to help once you send the list.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll send you the list as soon as I’ve checked both spots, and I’ll flag anything still open.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m at the garage and sorting the tools now — if there are any spare parts or boxes left, I’ll handle those too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Dane — that’s a huge help. I’ll spread the word for more neighbors and point anyone with spare parts or boxes your way.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll keep sorting here at the garage and set aside any parts or boxes that come in.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Leo — I’d feel better if we double-check the route and make sure the tools and spare parts are loaded before we head out.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll double-check the route and make sure the tools and spare parts are loaded.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Leo — that really helps. I’ll check the timing once more, and then we can head out.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’m coordinating the repair drive, and I’ll send you the details and the urgent repairs list soon.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Which spots still need coverage?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m still filling a few gaps at the north side and the community shed, and I’ll send the full list shortly.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do—I’ll swing by later and let you know if they still need a hand or any supplies.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Tess — I appreciate it. Swing by Sunday at the community center, and let me know if you spot any urgent repairs or extra supplies needed.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You got it — I’ll stop by Sunday at the community center and pass along anything urgent I see.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got the north block marked covered; tell me the next spot you want me to check, and I’ll note what’s still open.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Opal — could you check the east side next? I’d like to know what’s still open there before we head out.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — I’ll check the east side next and note any open spots there for you.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still piecing together the latest update, but I’ll pass it along as soon as I have it. If you’ve heard anything new about the repair drive, I’m all ears.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I’m a bit foggy on the latest, but I’m happy to help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Oren — I’m still waiting on the newest details too, but I’ll share them as soon as I get them. If you hear anything before I do, please send it my way.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I’m happy to bring my toolbox and help out wherever they need an extra hand.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—just keep me posted on what’s still needed, and I’ll bring by anything useful I spot.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Will do — I’ll keep an eye out and let you know what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yep, I’m still good — I’ll bring the tools by this afternoon and keep an eye out for anything else useful.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, Noah — thanks for bringing the tools. I’ll keep spreading the word for more hands and anyone who can help with bikes or small appliances.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good — I’ll be there this afternoon with the tools, and I’ll bring anything else useful if I find it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me, Tess. Just send me the time and I’ll bring gloves and a small flashlight.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, Eli—I’ll swing by later and let you know what time they still need folks. Gloves and a flashlight sound super handy.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Tess. I’ll be ready and waiting for your update.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, I’ll see it for myself after errands and check whether they still need tools or an extra hour of coverage.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — can you confirm that once you check, you’ll send the repair drive details back? I’m not calling it settled until I see the plan.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yes — I’ll check it after errands and send you the details back. Then you can see the plan for yourself.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure thing — I’m by the garage now, sorting the left-shelf tools and boxes, and I’ll flag anything missing or useful spare parts I find.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, thanks Dane — please flag anything urgent or useful, and send me a quick list when you’re done.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Will do — I’ll keep sorting and send you a quick list once I’m done.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely — I’m still keeping the repair drive needs list updated. If you spot anything missing, send it my way and I’ll add it in.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll keep an eye out and send anything missing your way.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect — thanks, Sam. I’ll keep the list updated and resend the latest needs if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Mina — I’m just making sure the route, timing, and supplies are all squared away before we head out.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Which spots are still uncovered, and what time are we starting?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I still need to confirm the route and make sure the tools and spare parts are loaded, then I can give you a start time.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still sorting the route and loadout, then I’ll send you the time for one more check before we leave.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good—just send the time when you’ve got it, and I’ll make sure pickup stays covered.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Will do — I’ll send the time as soon as the route and loadout are set.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — the repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center. If you can keep tracking supplies and lining up volunteers, I’ll keep the list updated and send you the urgent needs.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, Rosa — I’ll keep tracking the supplies and line up volunteers, and I’ll watch for your urgent needs list.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Mara — I’ll send the urgent needs list soon and keep you posted on any new repairs or changes.
